packageRules.description: Batch runtime, test and docs dependencies into one low-noise PR.
Lockstep the version-sensitive lint tools so local == CI stays true after an upgrade. prek pins the builtin hooks' implementations, so it moves with the linters.

customManagers.description: Bump versions annotated with a `# renovate:` comment in workflow files (the pinned uv, nox and git-cliff versions that no built-in manager reads).
Bump the seeded uv version default in the python-package-copier template's copier.yml, so freshly generated projects are born current. A no-op on repos without copier.yml.
